title: History: log, diff, blame and show

videos.script: A history is only worth keeping if you can ask it things. {{ask}} Four questions come up every week, on every team. {{four}} What happened recently? That is git log. {{log}} What exactly changed? That is git diff. {{diff}} What did this look like on Tuesday? That is git show. {{show}} And the one people ask with a frown. Who wrote this line, and why? That is git blame. {{blame}} The name is unfortunate. Blame is not for finding somebody to blame. It is for finding the commit, because the commit has the reason. {{reason}} Here is a menu where the price of bread went up, and rye bread appeared and then vanished again. By the end of this lesson you will find each of those moments in a few seconds, with the person, the date and the sentence they wrote. {{title}}
